source.author: verg
source.text: Non laudis amor, nec gloria cessit pulsa metu; sed enim gelidus tardante senecta sanguis hebet, frigentque effetae in corpore vires.
source.text_original: 'Non laudis amor, nec gloria cessit / pulsa metu; sed enim gelidus tardante senecta / sanguis hebet, frigentque effetae in corpore vires.
source.text_english: Not love of praise, nor glory, yielded when driven back by fear; but indeed cold blood grows dull as old age slows me, and the forces in my body have grown feeble and chill.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: olim annis ille ardor hebet, necdum mea proles imperio et belli rebus matura marique.
reuse.text_original: olim annis ille ardor hebet, necdum mea proles / imperio et belli rebus matura marique.
reuse.text_english: Long ago that fire has grown dull with the years, and my offspring is not yet ripe for command and for the affairs of war and the sea.
